hasil.skenario: GitHub NYATA: connect (PAT asli) + daftar cabang
hasil.raw:
repo        = vraafi/katalir-scm-verify
GET /user   -> login=vraafi id=209403877
rate_limit  -> core 5000 / sisa 5000
branches    = ['feature/verify-87590', 'feature/verify-87975', 'main', 'ui/ui-demo-88474', 'ui/ui-demo-88588', 'ui/ui-demo-88667']
CEK: PAT sah + repo terbaca -> True

hasil.skenario: Commit -> terverifikasi ULANG di GitHub (baca balik API)
hasil.raw:
commit sha  = e767bb3720568b9559519b552d5892a860e68d68
path        = workflows/verify-886-wf.json
created     = True
read_file() -> sha=8851e1d194ca…  run=verify-886
CEK: isi di GitHub == yang dikirim -> 8851e1d194ca3fc96a016022c6973ff2ceaa45c1

pull_workflow('verify-886-wf', 'main')
  sha       = 8851e1d194ca…
  flow_data = {"edges": [], "nodes": [{"id": "n1", "type": "trigger"}], "run": "verify-886"}
CEK: isi cocok dengan yang di-commit -> 8851e1d194ca3fc96a016022c6973ff2ceaa45c1

hasil.skenario: Rollback ke commit lama (isi kembali seperti semula)
hasil.raw:
commit v1   = e767bb372056…
commit v2   = 3283de047bd3…  (flow_data memuat 'versi': 2)
rollback(to_sha=v1) -> commit baru 530f1b4f6d97…
isi main sekarang = {"edges": [], "nodes": [{"id": "n1", "type": "trigger"}], "run": "verify-886"}
CEK: 'versi' hilang lagi (isi v1 dipulihkan) -> True

create_branch('feature/verify-886', from='main')
commit di cabang -> a723b8b4ba02…
branches sekarang = ['feature/verify-886', 'feature/verify-87590', 'feature/verify-87975', 'main', 'ui/ui-demo-88474', 'ui/ui-demo-88588', 'ui/ui-demo-88667']
isi di cabang     = {"cabang": "feature/verify-886", "edges": [], "nodes": [{"id": "n1", "type": "trigger"}], "run": "verify-886"}
CEK: cabang ada & isinya beda dari main -> True

hasil.skenario: Pull Request: buka PR nyata + verifikasi di GitHub
hasil.raw:
open_pr(head='feature/verify-886', base='main')
  number = 4  state = open
GET /pulls/4 -> state=open head=feature/verify-886 base=main
url    = https://github.com/vraafi/katalir-scm-verify/pull/4
CEK: PR benar-benar ada di GitHub -> True

hasil.skenario: Konflik: 2 commit bersamaan -> yang basi DITOLAK (HTTP 409)
hasil.raw:
sha dasar (dibaca proses B) = 2b8cd664cd1d…
proses A commit dulu        -> sukses
proses B commit expect_sha  -> RAISES ConflictError: konflik pada verify-886-konflik: dasar 2b8cd66 ≠ remote 9095af7
CEK: penulisan basi terdeteksi sebagai konflik -> True

hasil.skenario: Webhook push GitHub -> auto-sync daftar workflow
hasil.raw:
payload.ref = refs/heads/main
3 commit, 5 berkas (3 .json workflow + README + src/lain.py)
hasil sync  = {"branch": "main", "workflow_ids": ["verify-886-baru", "verify-886-hapus", "verify-886-wf"], "count": 3}
CEK: hanya berkas workflows/*.json yang diambil -> True

hasil.skenario: Multi-user: koneksi & token terpisah per user
hasil.raw:
store.list(budi)  = [{"provider": "github", "repo": "vraafi/katalir-scm-verify", "token": "ghp_\u2026ok"}]
store.list(orang) = [{"provider": "github", "repo": "orang-lain/repo-pribadi", "token": "ghp_\u2026in"}]
store.client(orang).repo = orang-lain/repo-pribadi
token asli muncul di list? False (harus False)
CEK: tidak ada kebocoran lintas-user -> True

hasil.skenario: Token DIENKRIPSI di penyimpanan (Fernet), dekripsi benar
hasil.raw:
ciphertext di store = gAAAAABqyCJ7k-uag32c3jwq06Sg2407bd2Re6FP… (140 char)
token asli ada di cipher? False  (harus False)
prefix Fernet        = True
store.get()          = token panjang 40 (cocok)
CEK: at-rest terenkripsi, in-use terdekripsi -> True

100 commit ke workflows/verify-886-perf.json
durasi      = 188.8s (1888 ms/commit)
sha akhir   = b435cbea54c8…
GET /commits?path=… -> 100 commit terdaftar di GitHub
CEK: semua commit benar-benar tercatat -> True

hasil.skenario: Token SALAH -> galat JELAS (401, token tidak bocor)
hasil.raw:
token   = ghp_token_palsu_… (sengaja salah)
list_branches() -> RAISES GitError: HTTP 401: {'message': 'Bad credentials', 'documentation_url': 'https://docs.github.com/rest', 'status': '401'}
token muncul di pesan? False (harus False)
CEK: 401 terklasifikasi + rahasia tidak bocor -> True
